Washing Machine X9 User Manual
SEPTEMBER 23, 2026 AT 5:22 PM

Applies to: Intego X9 for Mac · Washing Machine

Welcome to the User Manual for Washing Machine, Intego's cleaning utility for macOS. For installing and updating Washing Machine, see Getting Started With Your Intego X9 Software.

In this manual:

Welcome to Washing Machine X9
Basic overview
Scanning and cleaning (Reclaim, Duplicates, Organize)

❶ Welcome to Washing Machine X9

Washing Machine speeds up your Mac by scrubbing away old and unused files, recovers disk space by finding unnecessary duplicates, and helps organize your Mac for better productivity. It can:

Reclaim disk space to boost performance
Clean up unnecessary and duplicate files
Create Smart Folders for quick file access
Organize your Desktop, Dock, and files

System requirements: macOS 10.13 High Sierra or higher · Mac with a 64-bit processor · 1.5 GB free disk space

For installing and serializing Washing Machine, see Getting Started With Your Intego X9 Software.

❷ Basic overview

Registration: The first time you launch Washing Machine, enter your name (or company) and serial number in the serialization window, then select OK.

Free trial mode: Select Free Trial on the registration screen to try Washing Machine for 30 days — everything works except Clean and Tidy. Afterward, purchase a serial number or uninstall.

About your copy: Choose Washing Machine > About Washing Machine for your version, serial number, and a link to Contact Support.

First time usage: The overview window shows how much space you've freed. Start a cycle from the top-left corner:

Reclaim — Finds and cleans files you no longer need
Duplicates — Finds duplicate files by analyzing their actual data, not just names or timestamps
Organize — Cleans up your Desktop, Dock, and Smart Folders
❸ Scanning and cleaning
Reclaim

Select Reclaim, then choose categories to scan: Caches, Downloads, Languages, Logs, and Trash.

Use the Deletion Criteria slider (Safe vs. Aggressive) to control how much gets deleted, and double-click any section of the graph — or sort the list view by column — to see exactly what's being cleaned and from where.

Select Clean when ready.

Warning — Cleaned files can't be recovered.
Duplicates

Choose which file categories to scan (Folders, Archives, Movies, Documents, Music, Pictures), select Scan, then choose which locations to include or exclude.

Once the scan completes, manage results across three columns: Categories (types of duplicates found), Files (each set of duplicates, with a selected/total count), and Duplicates (individual copies of the currently selected file).

Auto Select speeds this up by automatically keeping files matching a rule you choose — Earliest Files, Latest Files, Shortest Path, Longest Path, Originals, files on a specific volume, or All Files.

Use Show to reveal a file in Finder, or Quick Look to preview it, then select the blue CLEAN button once you've made your selections.

Organize

Select Organize for three cleanup tools: Desktop (sort files into home folders, a Desktop folder, or Trash), Dock (reorganize icons by frequency of use), and Smart Folders (bundle frequently used files, visible in Finder's Favorites sidebar).

About Blueprints

Select the i icon in the top-right of any screen, or hover under any slider, for an explanation of what that feature does.

❹ Preferences

Open Washing Machine > Preferences, or press Command-Comma.

General — Reset help overlays or dismissed notifications; toggle anonymous usage-data collection under Feedback.

Scheduler — Choose how often the Washing Machine reminds you to run a scan (Every 2 Weeks by default, or Every Month/Every 3 Months), or turn reminders off entirely.

Advanced — Fine-tune scanner behavior:

Dock — Exclude apps outside Applications/Utilities from Organize scans
Reclaim — Include or exclude Trash on external devices
Duplicates — Move duplicates to Trash instead of deleting permanently
Secure Cleaning — Overwrite deleted files with random data (Basic/Medium/High = 1/7/35 passes) before removal
Warning — Secure Cleaning can significantly increase deletion times and isn't supported on SSD drives.
❺ Updating with NetUpdate

Washing Machine uses Intego NetUpdate, installed alongside it, for updates. Access NetUpdate from your menu bar or from Applications > Intego.

For more on NetUpdate, see Using Intego NetUpdate for Intego X9.
